title: Egyptian Minari Tagine
description: A hearty and spicy stew originating from Egypt, featuring minari and a blend of aromatic spices, perfect for a cold winter's night.

ingredients.name: chicken broth
ingredients.notes: vegetable broth for a vegan option

instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, coriander, paprika, and cayenne pepper (if using). Cook for 1 minute.
Add the minari, tomato paste, and chicken broth. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the minari is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
